outcome: multidisciplinary model of care (MOC) retention rate
viral PCR test completion rate after antiretroviral prophylaxis
cohort: The study included 129 live-born infants from 127 pregnancies exposed to HIV during pregnancy, born between September 1, 2009, and August 31, 2016, in Victoria, Australia.
finding: There were no episodes of HIV transmission, and while initial follow-up through the multidisciplinary model of care (MOC) was good, rates decreased from 95% at 2 weeks to 75% by 18 months, with MOC participants showing significantly higher rates of follow-up attendance and viral PCR test completion.
